questions.question: Differentiate between threats, vulnerabilities, and risks with examples. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Differentiate between threats, vulnerabilities, and risks with examples.
  • • Threats: A potential danger or harmful event that could exploit a weakness in a
  • system. (e.g., Malware attacks (viruses, ransomware), Phishing emails, Unauthorized
  • access, etc.)
  • • Vulnerability: A weakness or flaw in software, hardware, network, or human
  • processes that can be exploited by a threat. (e.g., Outdated software, Weak passwords,
  • Unpatched operating system, Unsecured Wi-Fi)
  • • Risk: potential damage from a threat exploiting a vulnerability (e.g., Data loss due to
  • unpatched systems attacked by malware, financial loss from phishing scam)

questions.question: Explain the different service models (Saa S, Paa S, Iaa S) with examples. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the different service models (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS) with examples.
  • SaaS (Software as a Service): ready-to-use applications (e.g., Gmail, Office 365)
  • PaaS (Platform as a Service): for app development (e.g., Google App Engine)
  • IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service): virtual hardware resources (e.g., AWS EC2)
  • Explanation of each in detail. (7.5 marks)
  • Architecture diagram (2.5 marks)
